TEMPLATES.TITLE: AI Agent Templates
TEMPLATES.DESCRIPTION: Use a template designed for business objectives such as assistance or sales, or create your own AI Agent from scratch.

ITEMS.RECEPTIONIST_DESC: Greets contacts, identifies their needs, captures essential details and efficiently directs conversations to the right team or person for further help.
ITEMS.SALES_AGENT_DESC: Greets potential customers, learns their needs, suggests suitable products and connects them with the corresponding team when ready.
ITEMS.SUPPORT_AGENT_DESC: Answers product questions using your AI knowledge sources and, when necessary, seamlessly escalates the case to a human.

CREATE.KNOWLEDGE_AFTER_PUBLISH: You can add knowledge sources, calendar and catalog on the capabilities page after publishing the agent.

CREATE_NEW.TITLE: Create new AI Agent
CREATE_NEW.DESCRIPTION: Add a new AI Agent to your team.

ADD.NAME: Add new agent
ADD.DESCRIPTION: Enter your new AI agent's details. This data will define the agent's behavior, so customize it to your business's needs.

DESCRIPTION.LABEL: Agent Description
DESCRIPTION.PLACEHOLDER: Enter a description of the agent

HEADER_CAPABILITIES.TITLE: Capabilities
HEADER_CAPABILITIES.DESCRIPTION_A: In this section, you can configure how you want your AI agent to help you respond to messages, provide information, or perform tasks automatically.
HEADER_CAPABILITIES.DESCRIPTION_B: Customize its behavior, response tone, and the features you want to enable. No technical knowledge is needed—just choose what works best for your business and let the agent do the rest.

CONFIGURATION.TITLE: Configuration
CONFIGURATION.DESCRIPTION: Clearly define what the AI Agent is responsible for and how it supports your business.

INSTRUCTIONS.TITLE: Instructions
INSTRUCTIONS.DESCRIPTION: Describe the AI agent's function, communication style, and actions it should perform. Provide step-by-step instructions using clear and practical language.

TEST_AGENT.TITLE: Test AI Agent
TEST_AGENT.WIDGET_ACTIVE: The test widget is active in the corner of the page. Use it to test the agent.

EMPTY_STATE.TITLE: Test your AI Agent
EMPTY_STATE.DESCRIPTION: To start the test, give your AI Agent a name and some instructions to see how it will respond in a real conversation.

ACTIONS.TITLE: Actions
ACTIONS.DESCRIPTION: Assign actions that the AI Agent can perform during a conversation. Each action only works if enabled.

KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES.TITLE: Knowledge sources
KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES.EMPTY_ALERT: Do you want your AI Agent to respond with greater precision? Add and enable knowledge sources to give your AI Agent the context it needs for precise and company-specific responses.
KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES.EMPTY_DESCRIPTION: To improve accuracy, we recommend training your AI Agent with company-specific documents and links.

RAG.NAME: Source of knowledge
RAG.DESCRIPTION: Add, edit, and delete files from the AI ​​agent's knowledge source, with precise instructions on how you want the agent to use this information.

FORM.NAME: Add information to the AI agent
FORM.DESCRIPTION: Add a PDF document with information about your business. Enter a unique name as your file identifier and precise instructions on how you want the agent to use the information in the file. Keep in mind that the agent will only use the written information in the file, so make sure your file is not protected and the written content can be extracted.
FORM.PLACEHOLDER_ID: Enter a unique name as an identifier
FORM.PLACEHOLDER_DESCRIPTION: Example: ‘Use this file when asked about…’

CALENDAR.NAME: Manage your calendar
CALENDAR.DESCRIPTION: Sync your account and authorize access to your calendar. This will allow the agent to view, edit, and add events on your behalf.

IMPORT.NAME: Import your catalog from a CSV file
IMPORT.DESCRIPTION_A: Import your products via an Excel file with a CSV extension. Use the
IMPORT.DESCRIPTION_B: to add your products with the necessary data. Please note that the first three columns are required fields.
